name: zomra-mcp

tools.name: zomra_login
tools.description: Authorize this MCP server without copying tokens: opens the Zomra website in the user's browser, where they approve the connection; the site sends the access token back to a localhost callback and it is stored under ~/.zomra/ (see zomra_auth_status for the exact file — it's isolated per configured site). Run this when tools report 'Not authenticated' or an expired token. Tell the user a browser window is opening and to click Authorize.

site_url.description: Zomra website to authorize against (default: ZOMRA_SITE_URL env var if set, else https://zomra.io — production). The API host is whatever that site reports back on approval; it is saved together with the token, and always takes precedence over any separately configured API URL for the lifetime of that login.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait for the browser approval (default 300)

tools.name: zomra_auth_status
tools.description: Show the current authentication state: whether a token is present and valid, where it came from (env var or stored login), who it belongs to, when it expires, and which API/site URLs are in use. Never returns the token itself.

tools.name: zomra_logout
tools.description: Delete the stored login credentials for this server's configured site (see zomra_auth_status for the exact file under ~/.zomra/). A ZOMRA_ACCESS_TOKEN env var, if set, is not affected.

tools.name: zomra_whoami
tools.description: Get the authenticated Zomra user's profile (id, name, email, instructor status, timezone, bio, ad-tracking config). Use this first to confirm the token works and to learn the current user's id.

tools.name: zomra_update_my_profile
tools.description: Update the authenticated user's profile. Only provided fields change.

tools.name: zomra_list_courses
tools.description: List courses. Defaults to courses owned by the authenticated user (owned_by_me=true); set owned_by_me=false to browse the marketplace catalogue instead.

assigned_to_me.description: Courses where I am an active co-instructor / teaching assistant

enrolled_by_me.description: Courses I am enrolled in as a student

tools.name: zomra_get_course
tools.description: Get full details of one course by UUID or slug.

tools.name: zomra_create_course
tools.description: Create a new draft course. Title/outcome/objectives can be filled in later; fields like category_id, price and min/max_students are applied through an automatic follow-up update. Next steps after creating: zomra_create_cohort, then modules/lessons, then a landing page.

course_outcome.description: What students will achieve by the end of the course

custom_category_name.description: Free-form category name, required when category_id is the 'Other' category

language.description: Course language code, e.g. en or ar

country.description: ISO alpha-2 country code, e.g. EG

tools.name: zomra_update_course
tools.description: Update a course's details, category, capacity, difficulty, language, pricing (base + per-country), early-bird and team discounts. Only provided fields change. Requires human confirmation (confirm: true) — see the confirm parameter.

course_outcome.description: What students will achieve by the end of the course

custom_category_name.description: Free-form category name, required when category_id is the 'Other' category

language.description: Course language code, e.g. en or ar

country.description: ISO alpha-2 country code, e.g. EG

confirm.description: High-impact action: set true ONLY after a human explicitly approved it. Calls without it return the impact summary instead of executing.

tools.name: zomra_delete_course
tools.description: Permanently delete a course. Irreversible. Requires human confirmation (confirm: true) — see the confirm parameter.

confirm.description: High-impact action: set true ONLY after a human explicitly approved it. Calls without it return the impact summary instead of executing.

tools.name: zomra_list_course_categories
tools.description: List course categories (id, name, slug). Use root_only for top-level categories; pass parent_category_id to list its subcategories. Category ids are needed when setting a course's category.

tools.name: zomra_get_course_activity
tools.description: Analytics: recent activity on a course (enrollments, submissions, reviews, lesson completions…). view can be 'events' or 'students'.

types.description: Comma-separated activity types to include (omit for all)

tools.name: zomra_list_course_team
tools.description: List a course's team members (co-instructors, teaching assistants) with their roles. Team invites/role changes can be done via zomra_api_request on /api/v1/courses/{id}/team.

tools.name: zomra_list_cohorts
tools.description: List cohorts, optionally filtered by course and status. Each cohort is a scheduled run of a course.

tools.name: zomra_get_cohort
tools.description: Get one cohort with its auto-generated weeks. Week ids from the response are required to create modules (zomra_create_module).

tools.name: zomra_create_cohort
tools.description: Create a cohort (a scheduled run) for a course. Weeks are auto-generated between start_date and end_date and returned in the response — use their week ids to create modules. Optionally duplicate all content from an existing cohort via source_cohort_id.

source_cohort_id.description: Duplicate modules and lessons from this cohort

tools.name: zomra_update_cohort
tools.description: Update a cohort's name, description, dates, status, or content-drip settings. Only provided fields change.

content_drip_enabled.description: Lock weeks until their start date

tools.name: zomra_delete_cohort
tools.description: Permanently delete a cohort (and its weeks/modules). Irreversible. Requires human confirmation (confirm: true) — see the confirm parameter.

confirm.description: High-impact action: set true ONLY after a human explicitly approved it. Calls without it return the impact summary instead of executing.

tools.name: zomra_get_cohort_publish_checklist
tools.description: Check what is still missing before a cohort can be published (pricing, landing page, curriculum…). Returns can_publish plus per-item status.

tools.name: zomra_publish_cohort
tools.description: Publish a cohort so students can enroll. Fails with a clear error if the publish checklist is incomplete — check zomra_get_cohort_publish_checklist first.

tools.name: zomra_set_cohort_enrollment
tools.description: Pause hides a published cohort from the landing page as an enrollable option; resume shows it again.

tools.name: zomra_list_cohort_students
tools.description: List students enrolled in a cohort, with enrollment status. Optionally filter by status.

tools.name: zomra_get_cohort_progress_stats
tools.description: Analytics: aggregate lesson-completion progress for a cohort (per-student and per-lesson completion counts).

tools.name: zomra_list_modules
tools.description: List curriculum modules with their lessons, filtered by cohort, week, or course. Modules group lessons inside a cohort week.

tools.name: zomra_get_module
tools.description: Get one module with its lessons.

tools.name: zomra_create_module
tools.description: Create a curriculum module. For online courses cohort_id AND week_id are required — get week ids from zomra_get_cohort. Lessons are then added with zomra_create_lesson.

sort_order.description: Position within the week (auto-assigned if omitted)

tools.name: zomra_update_module
tools.description: Update a module's title, description, or sort order.

tools.name: zomra_delete_module
tools.description: Permanently delete a module and its lessons. Irreversible. Requires human confirmation (confirm: true) — see the confirm parameter.

confirm.description: High-impact action: set true ONLY after a human explicitly approved it. Calls without it return the impact summary instead of executing.

tools.name: zomra_reorder_modules
tools.description: Reorder the modules within one week by giving each module id its new sort_order.

module_orders.description: Every module in the week with its new position

tools.name: zomra_get_lesson
tools.description: Get one lesson by type and id.

lesson_type.description: doc = rich-text page, video = recorded video, live = scheduled live class, project = assignment with submissions, embed = iframe embed

tools.name: zomra_create_lesson
tools.description: Create a lesson inside a module. lesson_type selects the kind (doc/video/live/project/embed); only pass the fields that apply to that type — the per-field descriptions say which. Example: a YouTube video lesson needs lesson_type=video, video_source=youtube, video_url.

lesson_type.description: doc = rich-text page, video = recorded video, live = scheduled live class, project = assignment with submissions, embed = iframe embed

tools.name: zomra_update_lesson
tools.description: Update a lesson. Only pass fields valid for that lesson_type (see field descriptions). Only provided fields change.

lesson_type.description: doc = rich-text page, video = recorded video, live = scheduled live class, project = assignment with submissions, embed = iframe embed

tools.name: zomra_delete_lesson
tools.description: Permanently delete a lesson. Irreversible. Requires human confirmation (confirm: true) — see the confirm parameter.

lesson_type.description: doc = rich-text page, video = recorded video, live = scheduled live class, project = assignment with submissions, embed = iframe embed

confirm.description: High-impact action: set true ONLY after a human explicitly approved it. Calls without it return the impact summary instead of executing.

tools.name: zomra_get_course_landing_page
tools.description: Get a course's landing page (description, requirements, audience, FAQs, cover media, status) by course id.

tools.name: zomra_create_course_landing_page
tools.description: Create the landing page for a course (one per course). Starts as draft; publish with zomra_publish_course_landing_page. The cover image cannot be set here — the user adds it in the Zomra web app.

course_includes.description: Which perks the course includes (shown on the landing page)

selected_free_session_id.description: Free live session to feature on the landing page

tools.name: zomra_update_course_landing_page
tools.description: Update landing-page fields. Only provided fields change. Note: landing_page_id is the landing page's own id (from get/create), not the course id.

course_includes.description: Which perks the course includes (shown on the landing page)

selected_free_session_id.description: Free live session to feature on the landing page

tools.name: zomra_publish_course_landing_page
tools.description: Publish a draft landing page so it is publicly visible. Fails while the cover image is missing — that is added by the user in the Zomra web app, not through these tools.

tools.name: zomra_list_orders
tools.description: Analytics/sales: list orders for the instructor's courses with filters (course, cohort, status, coupon, date range, free-text search over order number / student name / email).

tools.name: zomra_get_order
tools.description: Get one order with line items, amounts, discounts, and payment status.

tools.name: zomra_list_reviews
tools.description: List cohort reviews, filtered by course or cohort. review_type: public, zomra_team, or private_note. Set include_stats for aggregate rating stats alongside the list.

tools.name: zomra_get_course_review_stats
tools.description: Analytics: aggregate review statistics for a course (average rating, count, distribution) across all its cohorts.

tools.name: zomra_list_discount_usage
tools.description: Analytics: who used a course's early-bird or team discount, per order.

tools.name: zomra_list_coupons
tools.description: List the instructor's coupons, optionally scoped to a course.

tools.name: zomra_get_coupon
tools.description: Get one coupon with its scopes and settings.

tools.name: zomra_list_coupon_card_designs
tools.description: List available coupon card designs. A card_design_id is required to create a coupon.

tools.name: zomra_suggest_coupon_code
tools.description: Generate an available promo-code suggestion for a course.

tools.name: zomra_create_coupon
tools.description: Create a promo coupon. Requires name, code (4–20 alphanumeric), discount_type + discount_value, card_design_id (zomra_list_coupon_card_designs) and at least one course/cohort scope. Fixed discounts also need currency.

cohort_id.description: Omit to apply to all cohorts of the course

scopes.description: Course/cohort scopes the coupon applies to (at least one)

tools.name: zomra_update_coupon
tools.description: Update a coupon's settings. Passing scopes replaces ALL scopes (at least one required). Only provided fields change.

cohort_id.description: Omit to apply to all cohorts of the course

scopes.description: Course/cohort scopes the coupon applies to (at least one)

tools.name: zomra_set_coupon_status
tools.description: Deactivate a coupon (stops redemptions) or reactivate it later.

tools.name: zomra_list_coupon_redemptions
tools.description: Analytics: list redemptions of a coupon (who used it and when).

tools.name: zomra_list_live_sessions
tools.description: List free live sessions (webinars). Defaults to sessions owned by the authenticated user; set owned_by_me=false to browse all published sessions.

tools.name: zomra_get_live_session
tools.description: Get one live session by UUID or slug.

tools.name: zomra_create_live_session
tools.description: Create a draft free live session (webinar). All fields optional at creation; complete them before publishing.

promoted_course_id.description: Course promoted at the end of the session

tools.name: zomra_update_live_session
tools.description: Update a live session. Only provided fields change.

promoted_course_id.description: Course promoted at the end of the session

tools.name: zomra_get_live_session_publish_checklist
tools.description: Check what is missing before a live session can be published.

tools.name: zomra_publish_live_session
tools.description: Publish a live session so people can register. Check the publish checklist first if unsure.

tools.name: zomra_cancel_live_session
tools.description: Cancel a published live session (notifies registrants). Requires human confirmation (confirm: true) — see the confirm parameter.

confirm.description: High-impact action: set true ONLY after a human explicitly approved it. Calls without it return the impact summary instead of executing.

tools.name: zomra_list_live_session_attendees
tools.description: Analytics: list everyone registered for a live session (name, email, registration time).

instructions:
Tools for the Zomra course platform, acting as the authenticated user (usually an instructor).
Authentication: if a tool reports 'Not authenticated' or an expired token, run zomra_login — it opens the Zomra website in the user's browser to authorize this server with one click (no token copying). zomra_auth_status shows the current state.
Typical course-building flow: zomra_create_course → zomra_create_cohort (weeks are auto-generated) → zomra_create_module per week → zomra_create_lesson per module → zomra_create_course_landing_page → zomra_get_cohort_publish_checklist → zomra_publish_cohort.
Analytics live in zomra_get_course_activity, zomra_get_cohort_progress_stats, zomra_list_cohort_students, zomra_list_orders, zomra_get_course_review_stats, zomra_list_discount_usage, and zomra_list_coupon_redemptions.
These typed tools are the complete surface: there is deliberately no raw API access and no media handling. Media (cover images, video uploads, recordings, attachments) is managed by the user in the Zomra web app — never try to upload, attach, or work around media through other means; tell the user to do it on the website.
High-impact actions (deleting anything, cancelling a live session, changing course pricing, raw DELETEs) return a confirmation_required payload first: show the impact to the human, get their explicit approval, then re-call with confirm: true. Never set confirm: true without human approval.
